pages.title: Answer Pedestal
pages.text: A plinth that waits for a conclusion. When the right answer is placed on it, the surrounding proof settles into consistency and the room grows quiet. A wrong answer sits there and does nothing at all.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)At the heart of each proof chamber stood this pedestal. I understood it once I realised the whole chamber was a theorem waiting for its final line.
